gallery.description: Fig. 668.—The arms used by Kilmarnock, Ayrshire, based on arms from Clan Boyd, Earls of Kilmarnock: Azure, a fess chequy gules and argent. Crest: a dexter hand raised in benediction. Supporters: on either side a squirrel sejant proper.
